name: Compartment
description: Compartment is a CLI-first platform for deploying to Kubernetes. You declare your workload in a single compartment.yml file and the tool handles the rest, baking in gVisor isolation for stronger sandboxing, SSO, and role-based access control. It reached v0.10 this week, signaling an actively maintained project. For teams that prefer GitOps-style, terminal-driven workflows over heavy dashboards, Compartment offers a lighter, more focused path to running services on a cluster.
highlights: Declare workloads in a single compartment.yml file
gVisor isolation for stronger workload sandboxing
v0.10 released this week — actively developed
curatorNote: A CLI-first Kubernetes deploy platform with gVisor isolation is a refreshing alternative to the dashboard-heavy platforms. Declaring everything in one YAML file keeps the mental model small.
